the factors influencing intention to adopt smart speaker in smart home environment were attitude, social influence, trust and perceived usefulness.
intention to adopt smart speaker was influenced by perceived usefulness, perceived ease-of-use, attitude, social influence, and trust.
perceived usefulness, perceived ease, enjoyment, social influence, trust, self innovativeness and attitude have significant influence on the intention to adopt smart speaker.

the factors that influence consumers' intention to purchase smart speakers.
the intention of users to adopt smart speakers.
the adoption of smart speakers in smart homes.

trust is the key factor that can predict consumers' intention to use smart speakers in their smart homes.
trust, perceived usefulness, perceived ease, attitude and social influence are key factors that influence consumers' intention to use smart speakers.
trust is a key predictor for consumers' intention towards adopting smart speakers.

smart speakers are not just a device to play music but they can be an essential tool to improve the quality of life in smart home environment.
trust is a significant factor that influences consumers' intention to buy and adopt smart speakers.
smart speaker adoption is not only influenced by individual characteristics, perceived usefulness, perceived ease-of-use and attitude, but also influenced by social context and economic factors.

the trust of the users is the key factor for the intention to adopt.
